detail: Fresh packaged Linux release opens passkey setup without existing credentials.
Browser virtual passkey claims the release and admits GraphQL.
The final passkey cannot be removed.
Unclaimed and signed-out requests cannot read GraphQL or private artifacts; signed-out WebSocket is denied.
Authenticated requests with foreign Origin or Host are rejected.
Stored browser session survives server restart.
Logout revokes protected reads and writes in another tab.
A fresh passkey ceremony works after logout.
Recovery enrolls a new virtual passkey; the consumed recovery code is rejected.
